remarks: WALKOUT LUXURY HOME BY CUSTOM BUILDER Happy Planet Homes. OPEN TO BELOW, 5 BED PLUS DEN. 4 FULL BATH! The open concept design features a gourmet Kitchen that dazzles with premium finishes, including a Spice kitchen, quartz countertops and modern open shelves in the dining area. The Custom feature fireplace wall truly highlights the grand scale of the open to below the living room. Climb upstairs to discover the large bonus room connecting the upper floor. The family oriented design flaunts 2 more bedrooms, an additional 4 pc bath room and the Primary suite overlooking the yard. The large primary bedroom displays a stunning tray ceiling, large walk-in closet and a spa retreat in the modern 5 pc ensuite. Every detail is carefully planned and designed to be functional and elevated, from integrated built-ins, to the tile backsplashes, soft close cabinetry and more. (id:67522)
